headline: Weathered Expanse and Mooring County Rage as Stlican Shelf Ignites
war_summary: Since our previous edition, strategic base volatility has centered heavily on Weathered Expanse and Mooring County, while Stlican Shelf has flared into fresh contention. Weathered Expanse logged six base transitions over the past two hours around Wightwalk and Crow's Nest, absorbing nearly 1,900 casualties as the map remains divided among five Colonial bases, one Warden position, and three ruined neutral sites. Mooring County continues its fierce meatgrinder, reporting over 2,200 two-hour casualties amid ongoing friction near Gravekeeper's Holdfast and MacConmara Barrows, leaving Wardens in possession of eight bases against three Colonial holdings and one neutral. Stlican Shelf registered three recent base exchanges centered on Briar and Breaker Town. In contrast, the violent rupture in Olavis Wake has swiftly cooled following complete Warden consolidation across all five bases, while the rapid exchanges at Checkpoint Bua in Marban Hollow have quieted down without a single transition in the last two hours. Sustained attrition persists in Nevish Line and is mounting rapidly in Dead Lands, where casualty rates accelerated sharply.
